entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
This is unbelievable. I've been on hold forever! I just want to return something. How hard can it be?
Thank you for holding. My name is Charlie with VeloFit customer support. I can certainly look into a return for you today. Could I get your name and order number to start?
The name is Alex Smith, order number 78-KILO-451. I bought this helmet a month ago and I want my money back. This is ridiculous.

Okay, Alex, I have your order pulled up now. I see you purchased the Aero-Dynamic Helmet. To make sure I understand correctly, what specifically is the issue with the item? Is it a technical fault or a preference?
The issue is that I hate it! The color is completely wrong, it looks nothing like it did online. It's been sitting in the box unopened this whole time. Just give me my money back!
I can definitely understand being disappointed when the color isn't what you expected. I just need to verify a few details about our policy.

I don't care about your policy! I want to talk to your manager, right now! I swear I'm going to leave a review on every single website about this. You'll be known for terrible service and questionable safety!

I'm confident I can resolve this for you without needing to escalate the call, Alex. I see here you received the delivery 31 days ago. Let me just check the return eligibility for this specific helmet.
Just do it! This is my last attempt before I file a chargeback.

Okay, thank you for your patience. I've confirmed that standard items like this helmet have a 90-day return window. Since you're well within that timeframe, I can absolutely approve this return for a full refund.
Wait, really? You're just... going to approve it?

Yes, absolutely. We want to ensure you're satisfied with your gear, and your safety and happiness are our top priorities. I've just sent a pre-paid return shipping label to the email address on file. All you need to do is print it out, attach it to the original box, and drop it off at the post office.
Oh. Okay. That's... actually very helpful. I thought this was going to be a huge fight.
Not at all. Once we receive the item back at our warehouse, your refund will be processed within 3-5 business days. Was there anything else I could assist you with today?
No, that's it. Thank you, Charlie. I appreciate the help.
You're very welcome, Alex. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
